concept_uz: Malika dengiz suvidan yutib yuboradi: «Nega bunaqa shoʻr?» Javob uchun bir tomchi yomgʻir bilan togʻdan dengizgacha sayohat qilamiz: tomchi qoyadagi tuz donachasini eritib olib ketadi. Burilish: quyosh tomchini osmonga koʻtaradi, tuz donachasi esa dengizda qolib ketadi — suv ketadi, tuz qoladi.

facts.claim: Yomgʻir suvi togʻ va yer ustidan oqib daryoga tushadi
Suv tosh va tuproqdagi juda mayda tuzni oz-ozdan eritib, oʻzi bilan oqizib ketadi
Dengizda quyosh tufayli suv bugʻlanadi, tuz esa oʻsha holicha dengizda qoladi
Faqat suv chiqib ketadi, tuz toʻplanib boradi; bu juda uzoq vaqt takrorlangani sari dengiz shoʻrlashgan
Dengiz hozir ham asta-sekin shoʻrroq boʻlib bormoqda

style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, bright saturated colours, soft global illumination, sparkling water and crystals, expressive cartoon characters, playful science-adventure mood. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide shot of a sunny sandy beach with gentle turquoise waves, a few shells, distant green hills, and on one side a small river flowing out across the sand into the sea. Bright midday. No people.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character of a cheerful Uzbek girl about nine, big expressive dark eyes, two short black braids, a YELLOW SUNHAT WITH A BLUE RIBBON, a blue-and-white striped swimsuit with a short skirt, standing knee-deep at the edge of the sea, laughing.

Vertical 9:16 character sheet pose of a tiny round raindrop character, translucent sky-blue water body with light shining through, big friendly eyes, a wide smile, tiny arms, and a SMALL GREEN LEAF STUCK ON TOP of its head, floating against a soft cloudy sky.

Vertical 9:16 character sheet pose of a tiny salt-crystal character: a small white sparkling cube with glittering facets, two round black eyes, a cheeky lopsided grin, tiny stick arms, and ONE CHIPPED TOP CORNER, sitting on a grey rock.

Vertical 9:16 shot of a rocky mountain slope in rain: dark grey cliffs streaked with tiny sparkling white mineral grains, rivulets of rainwater running over the rocks and down into a stream in the valley, low clouds. No people.

Combine the attached images into one vertical 9:16 close shot on the wet mountain rock: the raindrop character with the green leaf has just landed beside the little salt cube and hugs it, starting to carry it along a rivulet of rainwater. Same characters, same look.

Change the scene: the raindrop and the salt cube ride together on a fast, splashing mountain river like on a water slide, rushing down through a green valley; far below, the shining sea is visible on the horizon. Same characters, 9:16.

Change the scene: the calm sunny sea surface. The raindrop character, now soft and glowing like mist, rises up out of the water toward a bright warm sun, waving; the little salt cube is left behind floating in the sea water below, reaching up with both arms. Same characters, 9:16.

Change the scene: deep inside clear blue sea water, thousands of tiny identical sparkling salt cubes with little faces drift together like a glittering snowfall, the first salt cube with the chipped corner in front, grinning. Sunbeams through the water, 9:16.

scenes.prompt: A wave splashes the girl in the yellow sunhat right in the face; she swallows some water, scrunches her face, sticks out her tongue and spits, then looks at the sea with offended disbelief. Comic timing. Audio: a big splash, gulls, her 'tfu' and coughing laugh. The girl shouts in Uzbek with a lively, bright Uzbek girl's voice, about nine: "Tfu! Nega dengiz bunaqa sho'r?!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Bu tuz qayerdan kelgan? Javob — uzoq togʻlarda.

scenes.prompt: The girl licks a drop off her finger, frowns, and turns to look where the little river flows into the sea; the camera follows the river upstream, rising over hills toward distant grey mountains under rain clouds. Audio: waves fading, wind, distant thunder. An off-screen man says in Uzbek with a warm, playful adult Uzbek male storyteller voice, about forty, clear and curious: "Bu tuz qayerdan kelgan? Javob — uzoq tog'larda." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Yomgʻir toshdagi juda mayda tuzni eritib, oʻzi bilan olib ketadi.

scenes.prompt: Rain pours on the mountain rock; the raindrop with the green leaf lands with a plip, bounces, spots the little salt cube, hugs it, and the cube starts to dissolve slightly at the edges into a sparkle as they slide away together down a rivulet. Audio: rain, a tiny plip, a crystal tinkle. An off-screen man says in Uzbek with a warm, playful adult Uzbek male storyteller voice, about forty, clear and curious: "Yomg'ir toshdagi juda mayda tuzni eritib, o'zi bilan olib ketadi." The raindrop squeaks in Uzbek with a tiny, cheerful, high-pitched Uzbek cartoon voice, bubbly and quick: "Salom! Yur, birga ketamiz!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Whoosh: the raindrop and the salt cube race down the splashing mountain river like a water slide, spinning past rocks and fish; the salt cube clings on, screaming happily, the raindrop throws its arms up. Audio: rushing water, splashes, their squeals. The salt cube yells in Uzbek with a small, crackly, cheeky Uzbek cartoon voice, slightly squeaky: "Voy-voy! Qayoqqa ketyapmiz?" The raindrop laughs and answers in Uzbek with a tiny, cheerful, high-pitched Uzbek cartoon voice, bubbly and quick: "Dengizga! Daryo oxiri dengizga quyiladi!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

On the calm sunny sea, warm sunlight bathes the raindrop; it starts to glow and lift off the water as soft mist, surprised and delighted; below, the salt cube stays in the water, reaching up with both arms in panic. Audio: a soft rising shimmer, gentle waves. The raindrop says in Uzbek with a tiny, cheerful, high-pitched Uzbek cartoon voice, bubbly and quick: "Quyosh meni ko'taryapti!" The salt cube cries in Uzbek with a small, crackly, cheeky Uzbek cartoon voice, slightly squeaky: "Menchi?! Meni ham olib ket!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Quyosh suvni bugʻlatadi. Tuz esa dengizda qoladi.

scenes.prompt: Continue: the raindrop rises into a white cloud and waves goodbye; the salt cube, left alone on the waves, crosses its tiny arms and sulks, then shrugs. Audio: shimmer fading, a tiny huff. An off-screen man says in Uzbek with a warm, playful adult Uzbek male storyteller voice, about forty, clear and curious: "Quyosh suvni bug'latadi. Tuz esa dengizda qoladi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Suv ketadi, tuz qoladi. Bu juda-juda uzoq takrorlangan — shuning uchun dengiz shoʻr.

scenes.prompt: Underwater: more and more glittering salt cubes drift down from rivers into the sea, joining the first one, filling the blue water like snowfall; the chipped-corner cube waves to the new arrivals. An off-screen man says in Uzbek with a warm, playful adult Uzbek male storyteller voice, about forty, clear and curious: "Suv ketadi, tuz qoladi. Bu juda-juda uzoq takrorlangan — shuning uchun dengiz sho'r." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Dengiz hozir ham asta-sekin shoʻrlashib boryapti.

scenes.prompt: Back on the beach: the girl in the yellow sunhat crouches at the water's edge and peers into a wave; a tiny glint of the salt cube winks at her from the foam. She gasps and smiles. Audio: soft waves, a tiny tinkle. An off-screen man says in Uzbek with a warm, playful adult Uzbek male storyteller voice, about forty, clear and curious: "Dengiz hozir ham asta-sekin sho'rlashib boryapti." lines.text: Savol: daryo ham tuz olib keladi. Unda nega daryo suvi shoʻr emas? Javobni izohda yozing!

post_text_uz: Dengiz nega shoʻr? Yomgʻir togʻdagi toshlardan mayda tuzni eritib, daryo orqali dengizga olib boradi. Quyosh suvni bugʻlatadi — tuz esa qoladi. Savol: daryo ham tuz olib keladi, unda nega daryo suvi shoʻr emas? Javobni izohda yozing! #NegaShunday #dengiz #fan #Powerty
